[RESPONSE] I’m here to start prenatal care because I think I’m pregnant. Over the past two months, I’ve had increasing breast tenderness, nausea, a 6.6-pound weight gain, and more frequent urination. I’m not sure when my last period was, but I stopped taking birth control pills six months ago and have been actively trying to conceive with my husband—we’re in a stable relationship. I shared the news with him last week and I’m really happy about it.
